## 2 — Implementation

- **`apps/web/vite.config.ts`** — `tanstackRouter` plugin BEFORE `react()` (load-bearing, REQ-TL-9's
  plugin half); `publicDir: false`; `appType: "custom"` (no index.html — SPA.3's shell is a Hono
  template); `outDir: "public/spa"`, `manifest: true`, `sourcemap: "hidden"`,
  `modulePreload.polyfill: false` (the inline polyfill would need a nonce slot).
- **Smoke scaffold** `src/spa/{main.tsx, routes/__root.tsx, routes/index.tsx}` — mounts only on
  `[data-spa-root]` (absent ⇒ inert, the islands' degrade-never-fail convention). `routeTree.gen.ts`
  is committed (eslint-disable + ts-nocheck header; `.prettierignore` entry added) so
  `tsconfig.spa.json` stays a pure `tsc -p` typecheck — checked into `typecheck` script.
- **`tsconfig.spa.json`** — sibling of `tsconfig.client.json` (island-deletion diff stays trivial):
  DOM libs, `moduleResolution: Bundler`, `vite/client` types, `verbatimModuleSyntax` inherited from
  `tsconfig.base.json`; `src/spa` excluded from the server `tsc -b` graph in `tsconfig.json`;
  eslint DOM-globals block extended to `src/spa/**`.
- **Scripts/wiring** — `build` = `tsc -b && build-client.mjs && vite build` (island pipeline byte-for-byte
  unchanged, REQ-TL-12); `build:spa`, `dev:spa` = `vite build --watch` (smoke-verified: emits
  manifest + hashed assets and watches); turbo `build.outputs` += `public/**` (covers
  `public/spa/**` on cache restore); CI `public-safe` builds `--filter=@rhema/web...` (web +
  workspace deps incl. `@rhema/api-client`) BEFORE gitleaks/marker-scan, and `check:spa-budget`
  runs after the scan gates — both gates read real artifacts, never an absent dir.
- **`apps/web/Dockerfile`** — `find public/spa -name '*.map' -delete` after the build (maps exist for
  CI provenance scans only; also refused by the `/assets/spa/*` name gate at serve time).
- **`scripts/check-spa-budget.mjs` + `apps/web/spa-budget.json`** — gzip ceilings from R25:
  entry ≤250 kB, lazy editor ≤400 kB, CodeMirror ≤130 kB, other async ≤150 kB/file, total JS
  ≤800 kB, CSS ≤60 kB. Fail-closed on a missing manifest. `fileURLToPath` for repo paths — the
  repo path contains `Rhēma` (percent-encoding bug found by the test, fixed).
- **README** (`apps/web/README.md`) — the dev loop: `pnpm dev:spa` + the watched SSR server.
- **License exceptions** — `caniuse-lite` (CC-BY-4.0: build-time babel/browserslist data, never
  shipped) and `lightningcss` + its platform binaries (MPL-2.0: optional Vite CSS peer now resolved
  once vite@8 entered the graph; axe-core/resvg precedents — build-time only, unmodified).

## 4 — React 19 SSR serialization drift (accepted, tests tightened)

React 19 changes `renderToStaticMarkup` attribute emission: boolean attrs serialize as
`required=""` (not bare `required`) and `formAction` keeps DOM-property case (was lowercase
`formaction` under 18). Three existing string-pin assertions failed; all other 4,586 tests pass —
no component changes needed. Assertions updated to pin SEMANTICS not serialization:

- `apps/web/src/server.test.ts` (~L471, `/signup` + `/login` invite-mode forms): locates the
  `<input>` tag containing `name="code"`, asserts `required` attribute presence via tag-scoped
  match; code-before-email ordering and the no-`<details>` checks unchanged.
- `apps/web/src/billing-surfaces.test.ts` (~L75): `formaction=` → case-insensitive match; the
  endpoint, `data-payment-link`, and `value="open_payment_link"` pins unchanged.
